title.zh: 在奥罗拉省Dingalan市镇Umiray描笼涯设立Umiray国立中学并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act to Establish the Umiray National High School in Barangayumirayin the Municipality of Dingalan in the Province of Aurora and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act to Establish the Umiray National High School in Barangayumirayin the Municipality of Dingalan in the Province of Aurora and Appropriating Funds Therefor

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2001/ra_9084_2001.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: There is hereby established a national high school in Barangay Umiray in the Municipality of Dingalan, Province of Aurora to be known as the Umiray National High School.
The Department of Education, Culture and Sports shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect immediately upon approval thereof.
